title: narcissus moschatus var. sabinii
intro: Narcissus moschatus var. sabinii, commonly known as Sabin's narcissus or Sabin's grape narcissus, is a perennial plant species in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus moschatus var. sabinii include analgesic and anti-anxiety effects, as well as the ability to relax muscles and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
